If I could change the world in one way, I would eliminate the illusion of separation—the false belief that we are fundamentally distinct from one another and from the natural world. This shift would dissolve the roots of greed, conflict, and exploitation, revealing the interconnectedness of all life. Without the need for domination or fear of scarcity, systems of oppression would collapse, and cooperation would become the default. The world wouldn’t become perfect, but it would be free from the suffering caused by division.
